auth.not: This is not a user login. A staff JWT does not call these routes.

endpoints.name: list_subscribers
endpoints.purpose: Read every stored newsletter address and its unsubscribe link.

response.active_count: Active rows in the whole table.
response.inactive_count: Inactive rows in the whole table.
response.next: Absolute URL of the next page, or null.
response.previous: Absolute URL of the previous page, or null.

endpoints.send_only_when: is_active is true. Follow next until it is null.

endpoints.name: sync_subscribers
endpoints.purpose: Make the stored list match the addresses Vincent is mailing.

body.confirm_empty: Required true only for mode replace with an empty emails array.

behavior.replace: The emails array becomes the full active set. Missing active addresses are unsubscribed.
behavior.upsert: Adds and reactivates the emails. Does not remove anyone.
behavior.tokens: An address that already exists keeps its unsubscribe token.
behavior.invalid_email: The whole request is rejected and nothing is written.

endpoints.name: resolve_unsubscribe_links
endpoints.purpose: Look up links for specific emails without changing the list.
endpoints.send_only_when: found is true and is_active is true. An unknown address is not created.

endpoints.name: public_unsubscribe
endpoints.purpose: The link a recipient opens. Vincent does not call this to build the list.
endpoints.behavior: GET shows a confirmation page and does not unsubscribe. POST, including List-Unsubscribe=One-Click, marks that email inactive.
